narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the alternatives to oral A-acid for acne treatment, specifically promoting the '1726' laser treatment offered at DRX Dermatology Clinic. It uses a professional yet approachable expert persona to address common side effects of medication and provides direct clinical advice.
